entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: A teenage Gruul on Ravnica who Planeswalks for the first time during the Burying ceremony.

entities.name: Sabast
entities.description: The Gruul shaman who performs the Burying on Domri and later tells him there are no laws of the Gruul except that of the wild.

entities.name: Murgul
entities.description: A Gruul warrior who holds a spear to Domri's throat on his return.

entities.name: Nasri
entities.description: A Gruul warrior who jokes that Domri is now one of the Golgari.

entities.name: Hasal
entities.description: The elder of three Cylian godtracker elves who shelter Domri in a cave.

entities.name: Maklo
entities.description: A younger elf godtracker who thinks Domri is mad.

entities.name: Elishta
entities.description: A young elf godtracker who is enthralled by Domri's story.

entities.name: Nikya
entities.description: A Gruul tribe member mentioned as one who does not know of other realms.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: A Gruul figure mentioned as not knowing of other realms.

entities.name: Cylia
entities.description: A power whom the Cylian godtrackers revere.

entities.name: The Burying
entities.description: A Gruul ceremony in which a youth is entombed in the earth, protected by a chant, as a test.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The tribal guild of Ravnica devoted to wild nature and destroying buildings, living in the Rubblebelt.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The law-bound guild that the Gruul scorn.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild of the sewers and decay.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: A guild Domri fears may have attacked his tribe.

entities.name: Cylian godtrackers
entities.description: Elf trackers of gargantuans in the jungle, to which Hasal, Maklo and Elishta belong.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Domri's city-covered home plane.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: The ruined district of Ravnica that is the Gruul home.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The void between planes that Domri sees when he Planeswalks.

entities.name: Old Gods
entities.description: Gods Domri believes are a myth held by the elders.

entities.name: Krokt
entities.description: A Gruul exclamation or deity invoked by Domri.

entities.name: Jungle Realm
entities.description: An unnamed primordial jungle plane where Domri first Planeswalks.

events.summary: Domri is buried in the ceremonial grave by Sabast, who chants protection over him.
events.quote: the shaman Sabast laid him in the ceremonial grave.

events.summary: Isolated in the dark, Domri's fear grows and he begs the Old Gods for deliverance.
events.quote: He knew the Old Gods were a myth—something the elders believed in.

events.summary: In a panic, Domri's spark ignites and he Planeswalks for the first time, seeing the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: He shot out into the Multiverse to behold the infinite void of the Blind Eternities.

events.summary: Domri awakens in a primordial rainforest with no buildings and is overjoyed.
events.quote: He was deep within a primordial rainforest

events.summary: Domri whoops in exultation, drawing a monster; three elves flee past him, calling him an idiot.
events.quote: Darting past him came three elves in strange garb

events.summary: Domri runs from a huge creature and is pulled into a cave by the elves.
events.quote: two hands shot out, grabbed him, and pulled him into a dark cave.

events.summary: Domri tells the elves of Ravnica; Hasal concludes he is out of his head and says their anima will wish to talk to him.
events.quote: Our anima will wish to talk to you.

events.summary: Thinking of the Rubblebelt, Domri feels a rush of mana and Planeswalks back through the Blind Eternities to Ravnica.
events.quote: And then, in a sickening lurch of unbelievable power, he shot out into the Blind Eternities once more.

events.summary: Domri sneaks across Ravnica at midnight back to the Rubblebelt camp.
events.quote: The streets of Ravnica at midnight can be a confusing place

events.summary: Gruul warriors Murgul and Nasri confront Domri and are shocked he is out of the grave.
events.quote: "Impossible," Murgul said. "You should still be in the grave."

events.summary: Domri refuses to tell Sabast what happened, expecting banishment.
events.quote: "I can't tell you what happened," Domri said, looking at his feet.

events.summary: Sabast refuses to banish Domri and tells him the Gruul have no laws but those of the wild.
events.quote: "I'm not going to banish you," Sabast said as he grabbed Domri's arm.

events.summary: Domri embraces Sabast and resolves to return to the jungle realm.
events.quote: In a rare flood of emotion, Domri embraced the old man.

relations.note: guides the Gruul tribe as shaman
relations.quote: it is for me to guide the Gruul
As long as you keep your spirit, Domri, you are Gruul
Even Cylian godtrackers, such as themselves, were careful not to get separated this deep in the forest.

relations.note: the Gruul want to tear down the city and the guilds fight them
relations.quote: the Azorius and all the other guilds fight us
four Gruul warriors had their spears at his throat.
but we have the Rubblebelt. That's my home.
